description: Plugins for LLM-assisted scientific research — currently: research-superpowers (skill-driven research workflow for theology, biblical archaeology, ancient history, and digital humanities).

plugins.name: research-superpowers
plugins.description: Skill-driven research workflow: idea → literature → ingest → draft → peer review → publication. Methodology-aware (hermeneutic / quantitative / mixed), with SOFT-GATE audit trails and optional MCP integration for verified citations. Focus-driven source ingest: pages capture project-specific extraction, not generic summaries. Works in Claude Code and Cowork — no terminal required for the core workflow.
